3-Stage WF to get 1.5K -Krea 1- quality

Tested on RTX 4060Ti 16Gb

  • 1 stage takes about 48 sec | Utilizes about 12Gb RAM and 13Gb VRAM

  • 2 stage - 87 sec | Utilizes about 13.5Gb RAM and 13.5Gb VRAM

  • 3 stage - 4 sec | Utilizes about 22Gb RAM and 10Gb VRAM

If you see that the final result is oversharped - just increase the value ofblur_strengthin theLayerFilter: Film V2node (Stage 3)
